description: Chintu aur Mithu milkar apna khoya hua moxa dhoond rahe hain. Bachche is gaane se cheezon ko sahi jagah rakhne ki aadat seekhenge.
learning: Teaches kids the importance of keeping their belongings organized and the concept of searching in pairs.
